name: lightning
steps: With the storm running and the thunder control ready, trigger Thunder.
Capture the first lightning flash, before the delayed rumble.
hud: From a soft patter to a passing storm.
Rain and wind smoothly mix three ambience loops. Lightning adds a delayed, varied 3D thunder sound; stopping the weather cancels pending thunder.
Listen to the weather settle in.
SPACE / RAIN   1 / LIGHT   2 / STORM   T / THUNDER
